title: Automate KMS/HSM and TLS certificate rotation for Private Installer (Vault + SealedSecrets + Helm/Terraform)
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds fully automated KMS/HSM key rotation and TLS certificate rotation for Private Installer deployments. Integrates Vault (transit + pki), SealedSecrets automation, Helm chart hooks, and Terraform modules for rotation schedules and IAM bindings. No manual downtime required; includes upgrade/rollback steps.
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private require automated key and certificate rotation for compliance (SOC2, ISO) and operational safety. Current rotation is manual and error-prone for on-prem/VPC installs. This change automates KMS (cloud KMS + HSM) and TLS cert rotation using HashiCorp Vault (transit + PKI), SealedSecrets for kube secret lifecycle, Helm hooks for rolling restarts, and Terraform modules for scheduling/permissions.

What this PR changes: - New Terraform module (modules/rotation) to provision rotation schedules, KMS IAM bindings, and Vault roles. - Vault bootstrap scripts and Kubernetes auth role changes (installer/templates/vault-bootstrap). - SealedSecrets controller automation: a controller job that re-seals rotated secrets and triggers Helm rollouts. - Helm chart updates (charts/private-installer): new values for rotation.enabled, rotation.schedule, kms.provider, hsm.config, vault.pki. - Installer upgrade flow updated to detect rotation-enabled clusters and perform rolling restarts with in-memory KV cache warmup to avoid traffic spikes. - New integration tests for rotation flows in perf-canary.

Notes/constraints: - Supports Google KMS, AWS KMS, and HSM-backed keys (via AWS CloudHSM and PKCS#11 compatible devices). - Vault is required for on-prem installations; for cloud-hosted Private we wire directly to provider KMS + Vault as optional CA. - Backwards-compatible: default rotation.enabled = false.

Upgrade/Downgrade workflow (short): 1) Deploy installer vX with rotation.enabled=false. 2) Run terraform modules/rotation apply to create Vault roles and schedules. 3) Enable rotation.enabled=true in Helm values and perform a canary release. 4) Verify SealedSecrets reconciliation and cert issuance in Vault. 5) If rollback is required, set rotation.enabled=false and run terraform destroy for schedules; keys/certs remain valid until expiry.

Checklist: - [x] Terraform module and docs - [x] Helm chart values + hooks - [x] Vault bootstrap scripts + migration plan - [x] SealedSecrets automation job - [x] Integration tests - [x] Docs: private-installer/README rotation section - [x] Security review completed

How to test locally (high-level): - Spin up kind cluster, local Vault dev server (with PKI mount), and a SealedSecrets controller (controller-mock). - Run: 
  ./scripts/bootstrap-vault.sh --pki --transit --role installer-rotation
  terraform -chdir=terraform/modules/rotation apply -auto-approve
  helm upgrade --install private-installer charts/private-installer -f examples/values-rotation.yaml
- Watch SealedSecrets controller logs and Vault PKI certificates to validate rotation events.

Examples: minimal Helm values snippet: 
rotation: 
  enabled: true
  schedule: "0 2 * * *" # daily at 02:00 UTC
  grace_period_days: 7
kms: 
  provider: "aws"
  key_id: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/EXAMPLE"
vault: 
  pki_mount: "pki/installer"

review_comments: Daniel Kim (reviewer): Please ensure we have an explicit migration path for clusters that previously used static certs. Also add a flag to opt-out on a per-namespace basis.
Aisha Patel (author): Added migration docs and per-namespace opt-out via rotation.namespaces.exclude in values.yaml. See commit b4c5d6e.
Riley Chen (reviewer): The Helm post-rotate hook needs a readiness probe wait to avoid rolling too fast; suggested adding 30s sleep + readiness check.
Aisha Patel (author): Added readiness probe loop and a configurable delay. Updated tests to assert no 429 spikes during rotation (commit d1e2f3a).
Sofia Martinez (security): Verified that Vault transit key usage is audited and HSM key access is limited to installer rotation role. Approved pending CI.
CI Bot: integration tests failed on first run (timeout contacting Vault dev). Re-ran tests after extending Vault bootstrap timeout. All checks passed on rerun.
migration_plan: 1) Create Vault roles via terraform/modules/rotation. 2) Bootstrap PKI and transit (scripts/bootstrap-vault.sh). 3) Deploy Helm chart with rotation.enabled=true on a small canary namespace. 4) Monitor SealedSecrets reconciliation and Vault PKI issuance. 5) Promote to remaining namespaces. See docs/private-installer/rotation.md for rollbacks and emergency revoke steps.
security_review: Completed: Vault policies restricted to minimal required capabilities, HSM credentials never written to cluster state, audit logging enabled for key operations. Security team confirmed compliance with SOC2 requirements.
notes: Default behavior is off; operators must opt-in.
We recommended scheduling rotations during low-traffic windows and using grace_period_days to avoid throttling cert issuance.
Follow-up work: metrics for rotation success/failure (ENG-4187) and telemetry for KMS usage billing (ENG-4191).
